title: Quiz: HTML Templates and Components
description: Check your understanding of HTML Templates and Components.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What problem do HTML templates solve?
options: Duplicating the same markup across many pages
questions.correctAnswer: Duplicating the same markup across many pages
questions.explanation: Define shared structure once; templates fill in the differences.

questions.question: True or False: Templating engines let you write loops and conditionals inside HTML.
Fill in the blank: render the ${part} once, reuse it on every page
questions.explanation: Shared regions like headers belong in templates/components.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
